title: GUARD (fixed in 44a66c4f71) — was: the `_most_recent_file` widget (^Xm) on a word no file matches leaves the line unchanged, where zsh inserts `''`

retired.fix_commit_subject: fix(compsys): `_most_recent_file` (^Xm) inserts `''` when no file matches
retired.why: Completion/Base/Widget/_most_recent_file sh:21-22 is `eval "file=($PREFIX*$SUFFIX(om[${NUMERIC:-1}]N))"` then `file=(${(q)file})`. Without `^`, an EMPTY array in a substitution is first turned into the scalar "" (Src/subst.c:3910-3912), and (q) quotes with QT_BACKSLASH_SHOWNULL (c:4153), so a glob that matched nothing leaves one word `''`; sh:24 `(( $#file )) && compadd -U ... -Q -- $file` then adds it and zsh puts `''` on the line. The port quoted with plain QT_BACKSLASH and kept the empty array, so `(( $#file ))` was false and nothing was added. The fix uses QT_BACKSLASH_SHOWNULL in both branches and yields the single `''` word in the non-tilde branch (the tilde branch's `${(q)^file}` keeps an empty array empty, c:3910 `!plan9`).
evidence: FAIL on the pre-fix binary (1 row(s) differ: zsh `fzc0000 ''`, zshrs `fzc0000 zzq`), 3 of 3 attempts

observed.measured: 2026-10-28, a copy of target/debug/zshrs built from the shared tree carrying the fix (zshrs 0.13.56, 134037160 bytes, sha256_16 447c30ef9fc40d63) vs zsh 5.9.2 (aarch64-apple-darwin25.4.0)
observed.notes: both shells: `fzc0000 ''` after ^Xm (compinit's stock `#compdef -k complete-word \C-xm` binding) on a word that no WORK_FILES entry matches. The lone \x18 key is ZLE waiting on the ^X prefix on both shells, not a divergence.

observed_when_diverging.recorded_under: 2026-10-28, a copy of target/debug/zshrs built from the shared tree at 9c63da5c42 with _most_recent_file.rs at its pre-fix content (zshrs 0.13.56, 134036856 bytes, sha256_16 360bf13f0c5a0240)

origin: lane-9 widget-axis sweep (2026-10-28): stock compinit binds ^Xm to `_most_recent_file`; found by driving every compinit widget binding by hand with a pty stepper (`ls aple.txt` ^Xm ^Xm: zsh `ls ''` then `ls 'banana.txt '`, zshrs unchanged), since compsys_spec_fuzz's widget pool has no `_most_recent_file` entry
